A scroll-stopping 8-second vertical (9:16) fashion reel, filmed as one smooth continuous take. The woman in a red satin one-shoulder bodycon mini dress at a neon-lit city rooftop party at night.

SCENE: Stylish city rooftop party at night with pink and blue neon signs, warm string lights, glass railings and a softly blurred skyline.
CHARACTER: The woman has sun-kissed caramel-tan skin and dark-chocolate-brown hair.
STYLING: Outfit: Red satin one-shoulder bodycon mini dress with a ruched side. Accessories: Large gold hoop earrings, a thin gold bracelet, strappy black heels. Hair: Voluminous loose curls with a deep side part. Starting pose: Standing three-quarter to the camera, one hand on her hip, the other relaxed at her side. Expression: Confident, playful half-smile.

ACTION:
0–2s: Close-up of the woman's face turning to the camera as pink neon light sweeps across her cheekbones and her gold hoop earrings flash.
2–6s: The camera eases back to a three-quarter shot while she gives a slow, confident over-the-shoulder look and flicks her curls back with one hand as the neon colors shift across the satin.
6–8s: She settles into a confident pose with one hand on her hip and a playful half-smile at the lens, the skyline lights sparkling behind her. The final frame holds steady.
Movement: She stays in place with subtle, confident movement: a slow head turn, an over-the-shoulder glance, a soft smile, hair and fabric moving in the breeze, at most one slow hand movement; hands relaxed and natural.

CAMERA: Eye-level three-quarter fashion shot; slow smooth dolly-out from a face close-up to a three-quarter shot; 50 mm lens; smooth and stabilized.
LOOK: Cinematic fashion film. High-end fashion campaign color grade, soft bloom, crisp detail and a trending social-reel glow. Lighting: pink and blue neon key light with a warm string-light rim light. Color grade: glossy high-contrast night grade in hot pink, electric blue and deep red.

SOUND: No voice: music and natural sound only. Music: original instrumental, energetic pop-house track with a punchy four-on-the-floor beat and bright synth stabs; catchy and beat-driven like a trending fashion reel, with a memorable hook melody that repeats and a confident, head-nodding groove, no vocals. The beat is already playing on the very first frame, builds with every move, lands a bass drop exactly at the 6-second reveal in sync with the pose, and ends on a clean final beat by 8 seconds so the reel loops seamlessly. Mix: the music leads, full and punchy, with the sound effects landing on the beat. Sound effects: camera flash pop (0.3s), soft whoosh as she flicks her hair (3.0s), deep bass drop accent (6.2s). Ambience: distant city traffic and muffled party chatter.

KEEP CONSISTENT: She keeps the same face, skin tone and hair colour in every frame; outfit and accessories stay the same throughout the clip; hands look natural with five fingers each. Clean frame without captions, subtitles or logos.
notes: Flow settings: choose Veo 3.1, aspect ratio Portrait (9:16). Each clip is 8 seconds.
Same face every time: use Frames to Video (or Ingredients to Video) with the image you made from the Image Prompt. This prompt only gives skin tone and hair, so the face comes from your image.
If Flow says “prominent people”: try this prompt once with Text to Video (no image). If that works, the image was the cause: make a fresh image from the Image Prompt and use that one.
If Flow says “might violate our policies”: wait 5–10 minutes and try the same prompt once more (busy servers fail too). If it fails again, report the video number.

Music silent or weak? Use a copyright-free backup: YouTube Studio → Audio Library, filter Genre “Dance & Electronic”, Mood “Bright” and “Attribution not required”. Download a track and add it under the clip in your editor before uploading. Never use a commercial song.

ACTION:
0–2s: Close-up of a feather headband and a sparkling gold drop earring as the woman turns her head under warm Art Deco wall lights.
2–6s: The camera pulls back to a three-quarter shot as she leans one elbow on the bar, gives a little shoulder shimmy that sets the gold fringe swaying, and glances over her shoulder at the lens.
6–8s: She raises a slim glass in a playful toast with a bold, confident smile, confetti drifting through the golden light. The final frame holds steady.
Movement: She stays in place with subtle, confident movement: a slow head turn, an over-the-shoulder glance, a soft smile, hair and fabric moving in the breeze, at most one slow hand movement; hands relaxed and natural.

CAMERA: Eye-level three-quarter shot; smooth pull-back from a close-up; 50 mm lens; smooth and stabilized.

SOUND: Off-screen voice-over by a confident, warm Indian female voice, speaking Hindi in a playful and confident tone: at 1.3s "आज की theme…", then at 4.6s "Full retro glam!". CHARACTER: The woman has sun-kissed caramel-tan skin and dark-chocolate-brown hair.
STYLING: Outfit: Parrot-green lehenga choli with pink gota trims and a light pink dupatta. Accessories: Gold parandi with tasselled ends woven into the braid, kundan chandbali earrings, glass bangles in green and gold. Hair: Defined curls gathered into a full braid wrapped with a gold parandi, a few curls left loose at the front. Starting pose: Seated on a bolster in three-quarter view, one hand bringing the braid over her shoulder. Expression: Warm, bright smile.

ACTION:
0–2s: Close-up of shimmering gold parandi tassels swinging at the end of a braid, then the camera follows the braid up to the woman's glowing face.
2–6s: The camera tilts up along the braid and arcs around to her face as she brings the braid over one shoulder with one hand and gives a slow, bright glance at the lens.
6–8s: She smiles warmly with the gold tassels resting over her shoulder, the festive courtyard glowing behind her. The final frame holds steady.
Movement: She stays in place with subtle, confident movement: a slow head turn, an over-the-shoulder glance, a soft smile, hair and fabric moving in the breeze, at most one slow hand movement; hands relaxed and natural.

Music: original instrumental, playful Indian-fusion track with a dholak groove, harmonium notes and light claps; catchy and beat-driven like a trending fashion reel, with a memorable hook melody that repeats and a confident, head-nodding groove, no vocals. Ambience: happy mehendi chatter and distant laughter.
